definitions.explanation: Resentment or ill will that remains long after the event that caused it, often between people or groups with a history of conflict.

examples.japanese: {遺恨|いこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遺恨|いこん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}った→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Even after the match, a grudge remained between the two teams.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺恨|いこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流|なが}して→流す：01968_nagasu⟧、⟦{仲直|なかなお}りする→仲直りする：06307_nakanaorisuru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: They decided to let bygones be bygones and make up, washing away their old grudge.

notes:
A strong, long-lasting grudge, often carried between rivals or after a serious falling-out. More literary and weightier than everyday ⟦{恨|うら}み→恨み：00414_urami⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遺恨|いこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave lingering resentment
- {遺恨|いこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to hold a grudge
- {遺恨|いこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{晴|は}らす→晴らす：10538_harasu⟧: to settle an old score

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{恨|うら}み→恨み：00414_urami⟧: resentment — more general and everyday
- ⟦{怨念|おんねん}→怨念：06591_onnen⟧: deep vengeful spirit — stronger, almost supernatural
- ⟦{確執|かくしつ}→確執：17294_kakushitsu⟧: feud, discord — ongoing friction between parties
